content.short: Grass is a decentralized DePIN protocol on Solana that allows users to monetize unused bandwidth to train AI models.
content.description:
Grass is a decentralized physical infrastructure network (DePIN) on Solana that enables users to monetize their unused internet bandwidth. By running a node via a browser extension, participants contribute to a global network that scrapes and structures public web data for training AI models. The protocol uses zero-knowledge proofs to ensure data is sourced ethically and accurately without compromising the privacy of its contributors.

The network democratizes the AI data pipeline, rewarding users for resources provided to developers. As a leader in the decentralized AI space, Grass offers a scalable solution for high-quality data collection while maintaining a transparent environment. It empowers individuals to participate directly in the global growth of AI technologies.
